title: WorkPulse performance.goal_created v1
description: An employee goal entered DRAFT. Identifiers and the state only — goal titles and descriptions are sensitive and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the goal belongs to — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Goal state after creation; `activate` moves it to `active`.
